title: TranscriptSearchResult
description: The response to a TranscriptSearchQuery (joined by queryId). CITATION RULE (ADR-0097, normative): every hit — and the synthesized answer, when present — carries citations back to transcript events, files, or claims with minItems 1. A search result is NEVER a bare answer: the M6 gate is search 'how did we deploy X' and get CITED results (ch07). Snippets are convenience copies; the citation is the truth. BUDGET RULE: the result echoes the query's configured budget next to actual usage and an explicit truncated flag, making 'memory retrieval never exceeds configured budget' auditable per response. FRESHNESS: results are a projection over the ledger; the freshness envelope (stale/lastLedgerSeq/headSeq) follows the C-routes convention — stale results are labeled, never hidden, and never authorize anything. Citation cross-field enforcement is runtime, per the compaction-packet pattern.

engine.description: What actually ran, for reproducibility and semantic-drift audits.

embeddingModel.description: Versioned embedder id used for the dense leg, when semantic/hybrid.

budget.description: Configured budget vs actual usage — the auditable form of the M6 budget gate.

truncated.description: True when more matches existed than the budget allowed. Truncation is data, not silence.

hits.description: Ranked matches. May be empty (an honest miss); each present hit must be cited.

snippet.description: Convenience excerpt, budget-weighted and redaction-filtered. Never the authority — the citation is.

agentNodeId.description: Join key when the hit is agent-scoped.

answer.description: Optional synthesized answer over the hits. When present it must carry its own citations (minItems 1) — the never-a-bare-answer rule applies to synthesis hardest of all.

projection.description: Freshness envelope (C-routes convention): stale projections are labeled, never hidden, and never used for command authorization.
